channel.description: 仅从 QQ 邮箱当天收到的 arXiv 推送邮件中筛选的论文

item.title: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
item.description:
中文标题：JEV作为评判者：自信时接受，不确定时升级

作者：Yubo Li, Yidi Miao, Ramayya Krishnan, Rema Padman

Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge enables evaluation across diverse tasks, but inference cost and confidence reliability become critical at scale. We study whether a decision-only judge can provide an economical first pass and identify when stronger evaluation is needed. Comparing jev-as-a-judge with sixteen generative and reward-model judges, with blinded human adjudication, we find it within three percentage points of a state-of-the-art LLM judge, our strongest comparator, on ordinary preference and evidence-grounded factuality at 0.36% of the comparator's fee. Larger gaps arise when judgments require checking a derivation or resisting an elaborately written wrong answer. On several benchmarks, JEV's gap to this comparator is concentrated in low-confidence decisions. A frozen cascade that accepts confident verdicts and escalates uncertain ones retains 99% of the comparator's accuracy at lower cost.

中文摘要：LLM作为评判者可在多种任务中实现评估，但在规模化时推理成本与置信度可靠性成为关键问题。本文研究仅做决策的评判者能否提供经济的第一轮筛选，并识别何时需要更强评估。通过将JEV作为评判者与十六种生成式和奖励模型评判者比较，并采用盲法人工裁决，发现其在普通偏好和证据支撑的事实性任务上与最强对比的最先进LLM评判者相差三个百分点以内，而费用仅为后者的0.36%。当判断需要检查推导过程或抵抗精心编写的错误答案时，差距更大。在若干基准上，JEV与该对比者的差距集中在低置信度决策上。一个冻结的级联流程接受自信的裁决并升级不确定的裁决，以更低成本保留了对比者99%的准确率。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作表明，在LLM评判中引入置信度感知的级联策略可在保持高准确率的同时大幅降低推理成本；但其优势在需要复杂推理或对抗性错误答案时减弱，提示低成本决策层适用于常规判断而非深度验证。

相关度：62/100 该文研究LLM作为评判者的低成本决策与置信度升级机制，与LLM和多智能体研究相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用，因此相关性中等。

item.title: REFLEX with Jev for Efficient Selective Control in LLM Agents
item.description:
中文标题：REFLEX与Jev：LLM智能体中的高效选择性控制

作者：Tiantong Wu, Wei Yang Bryan Lim

Abstract: LLM agents often use generative models for bounded decisions, raising the question of when these decisions can be handled more efficiently without reducing task success. We study REFLEX, an agent architecture that uses Jev as a fast, typed decision layer and calls a strong LLM when confidence is low, or generation is required. On a frozen 100-task benchmark, REFLEX achieves 95% success with 72.7% fewer strong-model calls than a strong-only agent, with reductions persisting across three fallback families. Controlled interventions show that reliability depends on action-set size and near-valid alternatives near authorization boundaries. External BFCL and $\tau$-style evaluations reveal limited advantages over a cheap generative cascade when ordinary routing is already highly accurate. These findings identify when selective control with Jev can reduce computation and where its benefits are limited.

中文摘要：LLM智能体常使用生成模型进行有界决策，这引出了何时可以更高效地处理这些决策而不降低任务成功率的问题。我们研究REFLEX，一种使用Jev作为快速、类型化决策层，并在置信度低或需要生成时调用强LLM的智能体架构。在一个冻结的100任务基准上，REFLEX达到95%成功率，强模型调用次数比仅用强模型的智能体减少72.7%，且该减少在三种回退族中持续存在。受控干预表明，可靠性取决于动作集大小以及授权边界附近的近有效替代方案。外部BFCL和τ风格评估显示，当普通路由已经高度准确时，其相对于廉价生成式级联的优势有限。这些发现识别了使用Jev进行选择性控制何时能减少计算，以及其收益有限之处。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作表明，在LLM智能体中引入类型化快速决策层并按置信度升级，可显著减少强模型调用并保持高成功率；但其收益受动作集规模和边界模糊性制约，在路由已高度准确时优势有限。

相关度：58/100 该文研究LLM智能体中基于Jev的选择性控制与高效决策，与LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间应用，相关性中等。

item.title: Semantically-Guided Domain Randomization for Industrial Object Detection in Low-Image-Budget Regimes
item.description:
中文标题：低图像预算场景下工业目标检测的语义引导域随机化

作者：Jose Moises Araya-Martinez, Gautham Mohan, and Jens Lambrecht

Abstract: Retraining visual perception pipelines in High-Mix, Low-Volume (HMLV) automotive manufacturing must be carried out under tight annotation, energy, and time budgets, yet most Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) strategies still operate in the thousands of images. This work evaluates Semantically-Guided Domain Randomization (S-GDR), an annotation-free adaptation pipeline that couples Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based semantic captioning of a small unannotated real reference set with diffusion-based background synthesis (Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) conditioned by ControlNet and IP-Adapter) and mask-based object composition. On an automotive multi-object detection benchmark and with a fixed budget of 200 synthetic training images, S-GDR reaches mAP50-95 = 0.739 on a real held-out test set, outperforming a domain-randomized render baseline (mAP50-95 = 0.697) as well as brightness filtering, perceptual hashing, CycleGAN style transfer, and unguided diffusion variants sharing the same 200-image budget. These initial observations position S-GDR as a promising annotation- free alternative for extreme data-scarcity regimes.

中文摘要：在高混合、低产量的汽车制造中，重新训练视觉感知流程必须在严格的标注、能耗和时间预算下进行，然而大多数合成数据生成（SDG）策略仍以数千张图像运行。本文评估语义引导域随机化（S-GDR），一种无需标注的适应流程，它将基于视觉语言模型（VLM）对小型未标注真实参考集的语义描述与基于扩散的背景合成（由ControlNet和IP-Adapter条件化的Stable Diffusion XL（SDXL））以及基于掩码的物体合成相结合。在一个汽车多目标检测基准上，以固定的200张合成训练图像预算，S-GDR在真实留出测试集上达到mAP50-95 = 0.739，优于域随机化渲染基线（mAP50-95 = 0.697）以及亮度过滤、感知哈希、CycleGAN风格迁移和共享相同200张图像预算的无引导扩散变体。这些初步观察将S-GDR定位为极端数据稀缺场景下一种有前景的无需标注替代方案。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究表明，结合VLM语义描述与扩散合成的无标注域随机化可在仅200张合成图像预算下提升工业目标检测性能；其思路对遥感等标注稀缺场景的合成数据生成具有潜在借鉴意义。

相关度：55/100 该文研究低图像预算下工业目标检测的语义引导域随机化，涉及合成数据与视觉感知，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合有方法上的潜在关联，但应用场景为工业制造，相关性中等。

item.title: ClusterFewshot: Improving Few-shot Optimization for LLMs workflow
item.description:
中文标题：ClusterFewshot：改进LLM工作流的少样本优化

作者：Omri Bar Haim, Shahar Katz, Lior Wolf

Abstract: The performance of large language model (LLM) workflows often depends on selecting a small set of in-context demonstrations to guide model behavior on new tasks. Recent methods improve this process by augmenting prompts with successful reasoning paths. However, their demonstration selection relies on random sampling or metric-based rankings, overlooking the semantic structure of the task. We propose ClusterFewshot, a strategy that combines semantic structuring with utility-aware scoring to construct representative and effective few-shot demonstration sets. Evaluated within DSPy-based pipelines, ClusterFewshot substantially reduces optimization cost across multiple benchmarks, while consistently improving accuracy relative to prior bootstrap-based methods in both standalone prompt tuning and hybrid prompt-weight optimization.

中文摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）工作流的性能往往取决于选择一小组上下文演示来引导模型在新任务上的行为。近期方法通过用成功的推理路径增强提示来改进这一过程。然而，它们的演示选择依赖于随机采样或基于指标的排序，忽视了任务的语义结构。我们提出ClusterFewshot，一种将语义结构化与效用感知评分相结合的策略，用于构建具有代表性和有效的少样本演示集。在基于DSPy的流水线中评估，ClusterFewshot在多个基准上大幅降低了优化成本，同时在独立提示调优和混合提示-权重优化中，相对于先前的引导方法持续提升了准确率。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作表明在LLM工作流中引入语义结构化的演示选择可同时降低优化成本并提升准确率，但其在空间任务中的适用性尚未验证。

相关度：62/100 该论文聚焦LLM工作流中的少样本演示选择优化，与用户研究中的LLM和多智能体方向相关，但不涉及地理空间数据或城市更新应用。

item.title: Annual Earth-observation embeddings encode wildfire disturbance and support simplified burned area mapping
item.description:
中文标题：年度地球观测嵌入编码野火扰动并支持简化的火烧迹地制图

作者：Jovana Knezevic, Clement Atzberger, Zhengpeng Feng, Adam F. A. Pellegrini, Srinivasan Keshav, David Coomes

Abstract: Medium-resolution (10-30 m) burned area mapping is vital for monitoring wildfires and their impacts, but remains difficult to scale. Existing methods require either curated fire-specific imagery or dense time-series analysis. Here, we tested whether annual Earth-observation embeddings retain wildfire disturbance signals sufficiently to map burned areas without either requirement. Using Tessera and AlphaEarth embeddings, we tested individual burn-scar delineation, mapping of all same-year fires within an area, regional wall-to-wall mapping, cross-continental transfer, and intra-annual fire timing. Tessera strongly encoded wildfire disturbance, allowing even linear models to separate burned from unburned pixels; the signal was weaker in AlphaEarth. Models trained on a single Tessera embedding matched or exceeded equivalent models using paired pre- and post-fire HLS imagery, and outperformed post-fire imagery alone. The same approach mapped all same-year fires within benchmark scenes (F1 = 0.90). Applied across California, with no California fire data used for downstream training, it recovered 97% of reference burned area and detected substantially more small and medium-sized fires than GABAM or MCD64A1. Separately, a model trained on 2018-2021 US fires transferred without retraining to 88 European fires from 2024-2025 (F1 = 0.88). For well-detected fires, ignition timing was recovered with a mean absolute error of 13 days. Performance declined for fires ignited near the end of the calendar year, and wall-to-wall deployment produced systematic false positives in some unseen landscapes. Annual embeddings nevertheless achieve high segmentation accuracy while moving the burden of dense time series processing upstream, providing a promising path towards simpler regional burned area mapping.

item.content:encoded:
中文标题：年度地球观测嵌入编码野火扰动并支持简化的火烧迹地制图

作者：Jovana Knezevic, Clement Atzberger, Zhengpeng Feng, Adam F. A. Pellegrini, Srinivasan Keshav, David Coomes

Abstract: Medium-resolution (10-30 m) burned area mapping is vital for monitoring wildfires and their impacts, but remains difficult to scale. Existing methods require either curated fire-specific imagery or dense time-series analysis. Here, we tested whether annual Earth-observation embeddings retain wildfire disturbance signals sufficiently to map burned areas without either requirement. Using Tessera and AlphaEarth embeddings, we tested individual burn-scar delineation, mapping of all same-year fires within an area, regional wall-to-wall mapping, cross-continental transfer, and intra-annual fire timing. Tessera strongly encoded wildfire disturbance, allowing even linear models to separate burned from unburned pixels; the signal was weaker in AlphaEarth. Models trained on a single Tessera embedding matched or exceeded equivalent models using paired pre- and post-fire HLS imagery, and outperformed post-fire imagery alone. The same approach mapped all same-year fires within benchmark scenes (F1 = 0.90). Applied across California, with no California fire data used for downstream training, it recovered 97% of reference burned area and detected substantially more small and medium-sized fires than GABAM or MCD64A1. Separately, a model trained on 2018-2021 US fires transferred without retraining to 88 European fires from 2024-2025 (F1 = 0.88). For well-detected fires, ignition timing was recovered with a mean absolute error of 13 days. Performance declined for fires ignited near the end of the calendar year, and wall-to-wall deployment produced systematic false positives in some unseen landscapes. Annual embeddings nevertheless achieve high segmentation accuracy while moving the burden of dense time series processing upstream, providing a promising path towards simpler regional burned area mapping.

item.title: From Utterances to Networks: Modelling Slang Adoption and Diffusion Across Subreddits
item.description:
中文标题：从话语到网络：建模俚语在Reddit子社区间的采纳与扩散

作者：Xiaoning Wang, Ted Underwood, Zhewei Sun

Abstract: Adoption and diffusion of neologisms in online communities have received renewed attention in recent years. As internet slang terms such as APT, referring to a K-pop song, and phrases such as Canon Event meaning an embarrassing but pivotal event, go viral online, it becomes increasingly important to understand the mechanisms that contribute to their success. Prior studies have often explained slang diffusion either from the perspective of social interaction or from the linguistic properties of the slang itself, but rarely from both perspectives together. One major obstacle has been the high cost of annotating slang usage in large-scale online communication. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs), however, make it possible to use them as scalable annotators for such tasks. In this study, we first curate a human-annotated benchmark to evaluate LLM performance in detecting slang usage in real Reddit communication. We then leverage LLM-based annotations to model slang adoption and diffusion. Our results show that slang diffusers with higher bridging capital are associated with increased subsequent adoption, whereas diffusers with higher bonding capital are associated with reduced adoption. We also find that wider contextual usage of a slang term is associated with a longer time before new users officially adopt it. Together, these findings suggest that both social-network structure and linguistic context shape the diffusion of neologisms in online communities.

中文摘要：该研究关注网络新词（如APT、Canon Event等）在在线社区中的传播机制。以往研究多从社会互动或语言属性单一视角解释俚语扩散，且大规模标注俚语使用成本高昂。本文首先构建人工标注基准以评估大语言模型在真实Reddit交流中检测俚语使用的能力，随后利用LLM标注建模俚语的采纳与扩散。结果显示，具有更高桥接资本的扩散者与后续采纳增加相关，而具有更高 bonding 资本的扩散者与采纳减少相关；俚语更广泛的上下文使用与其被新用户正式采纳所需时间更长相关。研究表明社会网络结构与语言上下文共同塑造在线社区新词的扩散。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作提示LLM可作为低成本标注器支撑大规模社会传播建模，其“网络结构+语言上下文”双视角思路可迁移至城市更新中政策话语、社区议题或网络舆情的扩散分析，但需注意其数据与结论均限于在线社区场景。

相关度：62/100 该研究利用大语言模型作为可扩展标注器，结合社会网络结构与语言上下文建模新词在Reddit子社区间的采纳与扩散，与研究中LLM应用及多智能体/网络扩散建模方向相关，但地理空间属性较弱。

item.title: SambaGraph: Action-Reaction Spatio-Temporal Graphs for Soccer Tactical Response Modeling
item.description:
作者：Abel A. Reyes-Angulo, Henry O. Velesaca, Steven Araujo

Abstract: Soccer tactics are interactive: an attacking action changes the opponent's defensive problem, and the observed response depends on the multi-agent match state. We introduce SambaGraph, an action--reaction spatio-temporal graph dataset and benchmark for soccer tactical response modeling. From tracking and event data for all 64 matches of the 2022 FIFA World Cup, we curate 4,070 action-centered episodes represented as temporally aligned 23-node player--ball graph sequences with attack/defense views, response labels, and 26,270 split-safe attack--defense pairs. We study three questions: whether observed responses can be classified from graph episodes, whether successful defenses can be retrieved for a query attack, and whether graph-derived summaries support grounded LLM reasoning. A compact signature MLP obtains $0.796\pm0.007$ macro-F1 for response classification, while a fused graph--signature dual encoder reaches $0.471\pm0.029$ Hit@5 and $0.655\pm0.051$ Hit@10 for full-bank defensive retrieval. Hard negatives maximize pair discrimination but not retrieval quality. Local LLMs underperform supervised encoders for direct classification and do not improve over a strong original order in eight-candidate reranking, but they provide grounded tactical rationales. These results position SambaGraph as a reproducible benchmark for graph-based soccer strategy-response research. Code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/areyesan/SambaGraph.

相关度：55/100 关键词命中：Spatio-temporal、Multi-Agent

item.title: Tipping Points in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems: Stance on Climate Change Action
item.description:
中文标题：基于LLM的多智能体系统中的临界点：气候变化行动立场

作者：Astghik Altunyan, Shimon Edelman

Abstract: Because significant action to counter global warming requires massive public support, it is important to understand the dynamics of public opinion on climate issues. Of special interest are social tipping points, as revealed by large-scale effects of small perturbations in individual behaviors. Agent-based models (ABM) are an effective computational tool for studying these matters, because they allow controlled and systematic exploration of the effects of interventions that may be infeasible in real-world social systems. Large language models (LLMs) have been used to endow model agents with the ability to communicate in natural language (rather than by exchanging predefined messages), as well as with personality (in the form of a narrative self and episodic memory). We leverage LLM-powered ABM to look for tipping points in the social dynamics of a micro-society in which some of the discussions are about climate change. Our agents' stance was defined by two variables: the strength of conviction about the urgency of climate action and the degree of trust in existing institutions. We quantified shifts in agents' "beliefs" by monitoring, across multiple rounds of conversations, (1) inter-agent distances in this two-dimensional stance space and (2) the patterns of discussion topics as modeled by Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA). Our findings to date suggest that significant abrupt changes in climate-change stance do occur in this simple model. We report a number of methodological lessons from this study, notably, the need to prevent LLM biases from interfering with the conversational dynamics and, more generally, to maintain agent personality and episodic memories of interactions in the face of such biases. Resolving these issues may allow for using ABM-derived insights in designing real-life interventions vis-a-vis climate change and other important societal challenges.

中文摘要：由于应对全球变暖的重大行动需要大量公众支持，理解气候问题公众舆论的动态十分重要。社会临界点尤其值得关注，它体现为个体行为的小扰动产生大规模效应。基于智能体的模型（ABM）是研究这些问题的有效计算工具，因为它允许对现实社会系统中可能不可行的干预措施进行受控和系统的探索。大语言模型（LLM）已被用于赋予模型智能体以自然语言交流能力（而非交换预定义消息），以及人格（以叙事自我和情景记忆的形式）。我们利用LLM驱动的ABM，在一个部分讨论涉及气候变化的微观社会中寻找社会动态的临界点。智能体的立场由两个变量定义：对气候行动紧迫性的信念强度和对现有机构的信任程度。我们通过在多轮对话中监测（1）该二维立场空间中智能体间的距离，以及（2）由潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）建模的讨论主题模式，来量化智能体“信念”的转变。目前的研究结果表明，在这个简单模型中确实会发生气候变化立场的显著突变。我们报告了本研究中的若干方法论教训，特别是需要防止LLM偏见干扰对话动态，更一般地，需要在面对此类偏见时保持智能体人格和交互的情景记忆。解决这些问题可能使ABM衍生的洞见能够用于……

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究将LLM智能体用于社会观点动力学建模，其方法论可启发城市更新中公众态度与政策干预的模拟，但论文聚焦气候变化立场，未涉及城市或地理空间数据。

相关度：55/100 该文使用LLM驱动的多智能体模型研究气候变化立场的社会临界点，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向高度相关，且涉及社会动态建模，与城市更新中的社会过程分析有潜在联系。

item.title: Spatiotemporal Kronecker Covariance Neural Networks
item.description:
中文标题：时空Kronecker协方差神经网络

作者：Andrea Cavallo, Athanasios Georgoutsos, Elvin Isufi

Abstract: Multivariate time series contain complex patterns that span across both space and time. While covariance-based statistical tools like spatiotemporal Principal Component Analysis (ST-PCA) help identify these patterns, they are limited to linear operations and prone to estimation errors with limited data. Recent covariance-based spatiotemporal neural networks offer more stable, non-linear alternatives, but they ignore correlations across different time steps. To solve this, we introduce the Kronecker coVariance Neural Network (KVNN), a temporal graph neural network that represents the spatiotemporal covariance matrix via a sum of Kronecker products where spatial and temporal dependencies are decoupled. By implementing filtering operations on spatial and temporal components, KVNNs achieve expressive processing capabilities, admit a rigorous spectral analysis, and are provably stable to finite-sample estimation errors, ultimately addressing all of ST-PCA's limitations. We show on five real-world datasets that KVNNs achieve strong forecasting performance, often requiring significantly fewer trainable parameters than competitive methods, and are consistent under estimation noise.

中文摘要：多变量时间序列包含跨越空间和时间的复杂模式。虽然时空主成分分析（ST-PCA）等基于协方差的统计工具有助于识别这些模式，但它们局限于线性操作，且在数据有限时容易产生估计误差。近期基于协方差的时空神经网络提供了更稳定、非线性的替代方案，但忽略了不同时间步之间的相关性。为解决这一问题，我们提出Kronecker协方差神经网络（KVNN），一种时间图神经网络，通过Kronecker乘积之和表示时空协方差矩阵，将空间和时间依赖解耦。通过在空间和时间分量上实现滤波操作，KVNN获得表达性处理能力，具备严格的谱分析，并且可证明对有限样本估计误差稳定，最终解决ST-PCA的所有局限。我们在五个真实世界数据集上表明，KVNN取得强预测性能，通常比竞争方法需要显著更少的可训练参数，并且在估计噪声下保持一致。

研究启发（模型推断）：KVNN通过Kronecker积解耦时空依赖，为时空数据建模提供了可证明稳定的谱方法，对地理空间多源时空数据融合与预测具有直接的方法论参考价值。

item.title: Multi-Term Fourier Graph Neural Network with Sample Relationship Learning for Enhanced Remaining Useful Life Prediction
item.description:
作者：Ya Song, Laurens Bliek, Yaoxin Wu, Yingqian Zhang

Abstract: Predicting the remaining useful life (RUL) is essential for effective predictive maintenance. Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks (ST-GNNs), which can model both temporal and spatial relationships by representing time series data as a sequence of graphs, have shown exceptional performance in RUL prediction. However, current ST-GNNs face several drawbacks. First, they require domain expertise or significant computational power to establish graph structures prior to deploying GNNs. Second, the models are restricted to capture temporal dependencies within a predefined fixed-size lookback window. This restriction ignores the common issue of varying time series lengths, leading the prediction model to miss short-term or long-term dependencies. Finally, conventional models often fail to capture the inherent relationships between samples generated from adjacent time windows, which are crucial for improving both the accuracy and robustness of predictions. To address the aforementioned issues, we introduce a novel framework called Multi-Term Fourier Graph Neural Network with Sample Relationship Learning (MTFGN-SRL). Rather than treating the sample as a sequence of graphs, we consider it as a single complete graph and utilize a Fourier Graph Neural Network (FGN) to capture the spatio-temporal information in the frequency domain. We propose a multi-term learning module that utilizes multiple lookback windows to generate samples with varying terms, which are then fed into the FGN to enhance the extraction of useful information from the data. Finally, we develop a sample relationship learning module by training a heterogeneous GNN to identify inter-sample relationships, resulting in enhanced accuracy and robustness in predictions. Evaluations on the CMAPSS dataset demonstrate MTFGN-SRL's superior performance over state-of-the-art methods in RUL prediction.

相关度：55/100 关键词命中：Spatio-temporal、Graph Neural Network

item.title: ME-VLM: A Unified VLM for Embodied Cognition and Agent Coordination
item.description:
中文标题：ME-VLM：面向具身认知与智能体协调的统一视觉语言模型

作者：Foundation Model, Li Auto Inc

Abstract: Physical AI requires models to ground visual and linguistic understanding in real-world environments while accounting for environmental constraints and execution feedback. We introduce MachEmbodied-VLM (ME-VLM), a unified vision-language model with two variants, 4B and 35B-A3B, that brings together embodied cognition and multimodal agent capabilities. Our work emphasizes physical perception and spatiotemporal reasoning, together with planning, interaction, and outcome assessment in both digital and physical environments. We construct training data spanning embodied and multimodal agent tasks, including execution observations and feedback to support outcome assessment and decision refinement. The training pipeline comprises embodied capability injection, separate reinforcement learning of embodied and multimodal-agent experts, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation that consolidates their complementary capabilities into a single model. Experiments show competitive performance on both embodied and agent benchmarks, as well as on autonomous-driving and embodied-navigation tasks. For edge deployment, visual token compression, W4A8 quantization, and hardware--software co-optimization enable on-device inference of the 4B variant on the M100, reducing prefill latency from 400 ms to 188 ms. Project Page: https://machembodied.com/ME-Brain/ME-VLM.html Code Repository: https://github.com/MachEmbodied/ME-VLM

中文摘要：物理AI要求模型将视觉与语言理解落地到真实环境，同时考虑环境约束与执行反馈。作者提出MachEmbodied-VLM（ME-VLM），一个统一的视觉语言模型，包含4B与35B-A3B两个版本，融合具身认知与多模态智能体能力。该工作强调物理感知与时空推理，以及在数字与物理环境中的规划、交互与结果评估。作者构建了涵盖具身与多模态智能体任务的训练数据，包括执行观测与反馈以支持结果评估与决策优化。训练流程包括具身能力注入、具身与多模态智能体专家的分别强化学习，以及多教师在线策略蒸馏，将互补能力整合到单一模型中。实验显示其在具身与智能体基准以及自动驾驶和具身导航任务上具有竞争力。面向边缘部署，视觉token压缩、W4A8量化与软硬件协同优化使4B版本可在M100上端侧推理，预填充延迟从400毫秒降至188毫秒。

研究启发（模型推断）：多教师在线策略蒸馏整合具身与智能体能力的训练范式，或可迁移到地理空间智能体中，用于融合遥感解译与规划决策等异构能力；其时空推理与结果评估机制对城市更新中的智能体决策反馈设计有参考价值。

相关度：55/100 该文构建统一视觉语言模型以支持具身认知与多模态智能体能力，强调物理感知与时空推理，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关；但聚焦具身与自动驾驶任务，未涉及城市更新或地理空间数据挖掘，故相关性中等。

item.title: SPARC: SuperPixel-Aware Region Contrastive Learning for Self-Supervised Dense Prediction
item.description:
中文标题：SPARC：面向自监督密集预测的超像素感知区域对比学习

作者：David Szczecina, Yuanpei Xiang, Jitao Hu, David Clausi, Yuhao Chen, Jason Deglint, Paul Fieguth

Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has become an effective approach for learning visual representations without manual annotations. Among SSL approaches, contrastive learning has been widely used for visual representation learning. However, existing contrastive SSL methods have focused primarily on image-level or pixel-level representation learning, while region-level representation learning remains less explored. We propose SPARC, a region-level contrastive learning framework that leverages superpixels to establish explicit correspondence between augmented image views. SPARC introduces a region contrastive branch that performs superpixel-based feature pooling and optimizes a region-level contrastive objective jointly with a global image-level objective. Under identical settings, SPARC consistently outperforms previous methods such as MoCo-v2 and DenseCL, achieving improvements of up to +9.79 mIoU for semantic segmentation and +4.88 AP for object detection. Ablation studies further demonstrate that region-level objectives produce the strongest performance. Thus, region-level contrastive learning is an effective approach for improving self-supervised visual pretraining for dense prediction tasks. Code repository can be accessed at https://github.com/xRIPEIx/SPARC.

中文摘要：自监督学习已成为无需人工标注学习视觉表征的有效途径，其中对比学习被广泛用于视觉表征学习。然而现有对比自监督方法主要关注图像级或像素级表征学习，区域级表征学习仍较少被探索。本文提出SPARC，一种利用超像素在增强图像视图之间建立显式对应关系的区域级对比学习框架。SPARC引入区域对比分支，执行基于超像素的特征池化，并将区域级对比目标与全局图像级目标联合优化。在相同设置下，SPARC持续优于MoCo-v2和DenseCL等先前方法，在语义分割上最高提升+9.79 mIoU，在目标检测上提升+4.88 AP。消融研究进一步表明区域级目标产生最强性能。因此，区域级对比学习是提升自监督视觉预训练用于密集预测任务的有效途径。代码仓库见 https://github.com/xRIPEIx/SPARC。

研究启发（模型推断）：该文的区域级对比学习思路可迁移至遥感密集预测任务（如变化检测、语义分割）的预训练阶段，超像素作为区域划分单元与遥感影像的地物边界具有一定契合度；但摘要未涉及遥感数据或城市应用，其实际迁移效果需进一步验证。

相关度：62/100 该文提出基于超像素的区域级对比自监督学习框架，用于语义分割和目标检测等密集预测任务。遥感变化检测本质上属于密集预测问题，区域级表征学习对多源遥感数据的特征提取具有方法借鉴意义，但与城市更新、时空数据挖掘、LLM多智能体等核心方向关联较弱。

item.title: Disentangling Topology and Diversity in Multi-Agent LLMs for Multilingual Low-Resource Emotion Detection
item.description:
中文标题：解耦多智能体LLM中的拓扑与多样性：面向多语言低资源情感检测

作者：Ulugbek Shernazarov, Charitha Ruwansiri Weerakon Basnayake, Abdelkhaleq El Jarjini, Noel Crespi, Praboda Rajapaksha

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems combine multiple inference calls, but prior work often confounds how calls are connected with how they are diversified. We study these factors independently: inference topology and source of inter-agent diversity. In a controlled $2 \times 3$ matrix, we cross parallel aggregation and sequential refinement with stochastic sampling, role prompting, and learned QLoRA specialization, under a fixed three-call budget and output protocol within each backbone. Using Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we evaluate all six configurations on multilingual low-resource emotion detection across nine languages. Parallel learned specialization is strongest on Qwen at 52.83 Macro-F1 and reaches 52.94 on Llama. On Qwen it also exceeds same-backbone zero-shot, few-shot, CoT, and seven-call self-consistency baselines. The preferred topology depends on diversity source: sequential refinement helps stochastic and prompted settings, while the learned Width advantage shrinks from 2.83 points on Qwen to 0.17 on Llama. Depth-wise analysis suggests that later learned specialists can overwrite correct early predictions, although the aggregate effect is backbone-dependent. Overall, how agents are differentiated produces larger performance shifts than topology, which should be evaluated jointly with specialization.

中文摘要：多智能体LLM系统组合多次推理调用，但先前工作常将调用如何连接与如何多样化混为一谈。本文独立研究这两个因素：推理拓扑与智能体间多样性来源。在一个受控的2×3矩阵中，将并行聚合与顺序精炼同随机采样、角色提示和学习型QLoRA专业化进行交叉组合，在每个骨干模型内固定三次调用预算和输出协议。使用Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，在九种语言的多语言低资源情感检测上评估全部六种配置。并行学习型专业化在Qwen上最强，达52.83 Macro-F1，在Llama上达52.94。在Qwen上它还超过同骨干的零样本、少样本、CoT和七次调用自一致性基线。偏好拓扑取决于多样性来源：顺序精炼有助于随机和提示设置，而学习型宽度优势从Qwen上的2.83分缩小到Llama上的0.17。深度分析表明较晚的学习型专家可能覆盖早期正确预测，尽管总体效应依赖骨干。总体而言，智能体如何被差异化比拓扑产生更大的性能变化，二者应与专业化联合评估。

item.content:encoded:
中文标题：解耦多智能体LLM中的拓扑与多样性：面向多语言低资源情感检测

作者：Ulugbek Shernazarov, Charitha Ruwansiri Weerakon Basnayake, Abdelkhaleq El Jarjini, Noel Crespi, Praboda Rajapaksha

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems combine multiple inference calls, but prior work often confounds how calls are connected with how they are diversified. We study these factors independently: inference topology and source of inter-agent diversity. In a controlled $2 \times 3$ matrix, we cross parallel aggregation and sequential refinement with stochastic sampling, role prompting, and learned QLoRA specialization, under a fixed three-call budget and output protocol within each backbone. Using Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we evaluate all six configurations on multilingual low-resource emotion detection across nine languages. Parallel learned specialization is strongest on Qwen at 52.83 Macro-F1 and reaches 52.94 on Llama. On Qwen it also exceeds same-backbone zero-shot, few-shot, CoT, and seven-call self-consistency baselines. The preferred topology depends on diversity source: sequential refinement helps stochastic and prompted settings, while the learned Width advantage shrinks from 2.83 points on Qwen to 0.17 on Llama. Depth-wise analysis suggests that later learned specialists can overwrite correct early predictions, although the aggregate effect is backbone-dependent. Overall, how agents are differentiated produces larger performance shifts than topology, which should be evaluated jointly with specialization.

item.title: What Does Multi-Agent LLM Debate Actually Change? A Layered Analysis of Disagreement and Answer Quality
item.description:
中文标题：多智能体LLM辩论中分歧与答案质量的分层分析

作者：Chen Qian

Abstract: Multi-agent debate, in which several LLMs exchange arguments before answering, is widely assumed to improve answer quality by surfacing genuine disagreement. That mechanism is rarely checked. We introduce four measurements: (A) the agreement a debater reports; (B) whether its reply text actually pushes back; (C) whether the position persists once the eliciting instruction is removed; and (D) for open-weight models, the stance response in the debater's own token log-probabilities. We evaluate three-model committees debating open-ended GlobalOpinionQA across 750 debates under three tones: friendly (seek common ground), neutral, and hostile (stress-test every position). (A) Tone strongly reshapes reported agreement: full agreement differs by 50.4 percentage points between the friendly and hostile endpoints. (B) A judge that reads only the reply text, never the self-report or the condition, recovers the same pattern. (C) The dissent appears partly tied to the instruction that elicited it: labels revert toward agreement 23.1 points more often after deleting the hostile instruction than under a matched re-ask that keeps it; question-weighted inference is inconclusive on first-round turns alone (p=0.0625), significant pooling all rounds (p=0.016), and only 11/28 first-round reversions also appear in the reply text. (D) Opposing arguments weaken a debater's stance margin more consistently than they shift its direction. For final answers we detect no quality gain: a bias-checked jury returns 299/299 ties (ruling out only large differences), accuracy on a verifiable control task is unchanged, and a jury without the bias check had declared debate the winner 66% of the time -- an artifact of reading order. Taken together, LLM debate readily changes what agents say, but we find much weaker evidence that it changes what they persistently endorse or improves the quality of the final answer.

中文摘要：论文通过四项测量分析多智能体辩论，发现辩论语气强烈影响报告的一致性，但分歧部分与引发指令相关。最终答案质量无提升，偏见检查陪审团返回299/299平局，而未经检查的陪审团因阅读顺序伪影错误宣布辩论获胜。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究揭示了LLM辩论中表面分歧与真实立场变化之间的复杂关系，并警示了评估方法中的潜在偏见，为构建和评估多智能体协作系统提供了重要的方法论警示。

相关度：70/100 论文通过实验分析多智能体LLM辩论中的分歧与答案质量，其发现对理解LLM多智能体交互机制至关重要，直接关联GIS博士研究中LLM和多智能体系统的设计与评估。

item.title: MARBO: Relational Belief Grounding for LLM Agents in Social Deduction Games
item.description:
中文标题：MARBO：社交推理游戏中LLM智能体的关系信念基础

作者：Yechan Hwang, Sangjun Bae, Jeongmo Kim, Sangwoo Bang, Seungyul Han

Abstract: Social deduction games (SDGs) require agents to reason under partial observability by maintaining relational beliefs about hidden roles and team alignments. While recent LLM-agent approaches improve gameplay through prompting and preference optimization, they often optimize actions and in-game speech without explicitly grounding them in such beliefs. This frequently leads to strategically inconsistent behavior, especially for compact LLM agents. We introduce Multi-Agent Relational Belief Optimization (MARBO), a belief-grounded preference optimization framework that leverages relational beliefs to guide strategic decisions and in-game speech. MARBO provides preference feedback only when behaviors are supported by reliable relational beliefs and lead to strategically favorable social outcomes, encouraging more consistent learning under uncertainty. Experiments on representative SDGs show that MARBO enables compact LLM agents to consistently outperform existing baselines. The Code is available on https://github.com/PleaseTakemeAway/MARBO.

中文摘要：论文提出多智能体关系信念优化（MARBO）框架，利用关系信念指导LLM智能体的策略决策和游戏内语言生成。MARBO仅在行为得到可靠关系信念支持并导致战略上有利的社会结果时提供偏好反馈，从而在不确定性下鼓励更一致的学习。在代表性社交推理游戏上的实验表明，MARBO使紧凑型LLM智能体能够持续优于现有基线。

研究启发（模型推断）：将智能体的行为显式地锚定在结构化的关系信念上，而非仅优化表面行为，是提升LLM智能体在复杂社会交互中战略一致性的关键。

相关度：85/100 论文针对LLM智能体在部分可观测环境下的推理问题，提出基于关系信念的偏好优化框架MARBO，以指导策略和语言生成。这与利用LLM进行城市更新中多方博弈模拟、时空数据挖掘中的智能体决策高度相关，其信念基础优化方法对提升LLM智能体在复杂社会空间环境中的一致性有重要价值。

item.title: StepKV: Step-Aware KV Cache Compression for LLM Agents
item.description:
中文标题：StepKV：面向LLM智能体的步骤感知KV缓存压缩

作者：Boyu Feng, Jiahong Liu, Yifan Li, Wenhao Yu, Zexuan Qiu, Yuliang Sun, Ming Shen, Xiang Li, Quanyu Dai, Irwin King

Abstract: Key-value (KV) caching is essential for efficient autoregressive large language model (LLM) inference, but the cache grows linearly with context length, increasing storage and decoding costs. KV cache compression mitigates this cost by retaining only a subset of cached tokens. This challenge is particularly important for multi-step LLM agents, where a query expands into trajectories of reasoning, tool interactions, and retrieved observations. Existing pruning methods typically treat the cache as a flat token stream and rank tokens by recency or attention saliency. This creates a mismatch between the unit of compression and the unit of reasoning: token-level pruning removes individual entries, whereas useful information in multi-step agents is often organized into reasoning steps with uneven and delayed importance. Consequently, an early observation or intermediate decision may receive little recent attention yet remain essential for later evidence synthesis. We term this failure mode Reasoning Continuity Disruption.These observations motivate KV cache compression that jointly considers token- and reasoning-step-level information. StepKV addresses this goal by treating reasoning steps as first-class retention units. It associates cache entries with their generating steps, estimates step utility from trajectory-derived signals, and combines this utility with token-level saliency. The resulting scores globally rank prunable tokens, from which StepKV retains the top-scoring entries under a target budget. StepKV thus provides a step-centric perspective for agent KV cache compression. Across multi-hop QA and long-horizon web reasoning tasks, StepKV sustains accuracy under low KV budgets where token-level baselines degrade sharply, offering a more robust efficiency-accuracy trade-off for multi-step agent inference.

中文摘要：键值（KV）缓存对高效自回归大语言模型推理至关重要，但缓存随上下文长度线性增长，增加存储和解码成本。KV缓存压缩通过仅保留缓存token的子集来缓解此成本。这一挑战对多步LLM智能体尤为重要，其中查询扩展为推理、工具交互和检索观察的轨迹。现有剪枝方法通常将缓存视为扁平token流，按新近度或注意力显著性对token排序。这造成压缩单元与推理单元之间的错配：token级剪枝移除单个条目，而多步智能体中的有用信息常组织为重要性不均且延迟出现的推理步骤。因此，早期观察或中间决策可能近期注意力很低但对后续证据综合仍至关重要。我们将此失效模式称为推理连续性中断。这些观察促使KV缓存压缩需联合考虑token级和推理步骤级信息。StepKV通过将推理步骤视为一等保留单元来实现此目标。它将缓存条目与其生成步骤关联，从轨迹派生信号估计步骤效用，并将该效用与token级显著性结合。所得分数对可剪枝token进行全局排序，StepKV在目标预算下保留得分最高的条目。StepKV由此为智能体KV缓存压缩提供步骤中心的视角。在多跳问答和长程网页推理任务上，StepKV在低KV预算下维持准确率，而token级基线急剧退化，提供了更稳健的效率-准确率权衡。

研究启发（模型推断）：该文以推理步骤为压缩单元的思路，对构建长程地理空间推理智能体（如多步空间分析、跨数据源证据综合）的效率优化具有借鉴意义，尤其在城市更新分析中智能体需整合多源时空证据时；但摘要未涉及地理空间任务，迁移需验证。

相关度：55/100 该文提出面向多步LLM智能体的步骤感知KV缓存压缩方法，与研究者关注的LLM和多智能体方向相关。其以推理步骤为保留单元的思路对长程地理空间推理智能体的效率优化有参考价值，但不涉及地理空间数据。

相关度：55/100 该文提出面向多步LLM智能体的步骤感知KV缓存压缩方法，与研究者关注的LLM和多智能体方向相关。其以推理步骤为保留单元的思路对长程地理空间推理智能体的效率优化有参考价值，但不涉及地理空间数据。

item.title: CoEvo: Oracle-Grounded Self-Evolution of a Single Model for Multi-Step Causal Reasoning
item.description:
中文标题：CoEvo：面向多步因果推理的单模型Oracle锚定自演化

作者：Jian Zhang, Bingyi Wang, Yizhi Liu

Abstract: Multi-step causal reasoning requires chaining inferences where each step constrains the next. An early error propagates silently, and a correct answer reached via flawed logic evades outcome-level detection. In specialized domains, teacher LLMs err on intermediate steps, safety constraints restrict cloud distillation, and shifting conditions demand adaptation, leaving self-evolution as the practical route. Naive self-evolution can collapse: outcome-only rewards let the model exploit distributional shortcuts, and weak self-evaluation reinforces spurious paths into stable failure patterns. We exploit a key asymmetry: generating a correct chain is hard, but verifying a single step is easy. Many high-stakes domains admit a deterministic, queryable oracle, a physics simulator or rule engine over codified constraints. It checks asserted steps without teacher-level ability and abstains beyond its rules; it can check what the model asserts, never replace it. This enables CoEvo, an oracle-grounded self-evolution framework where a single model alternates between Proposer and Solver. As Solver, the model generates competing chains; intra-group debate exposes disagreement steps, a proxy for the capability boundary, and the oracle adjudicates them into process-level supervision. As Proposer, the same model constructs progressively harder scenarios inside oracle constraints, steering the curriculum toward deep multi-hop chains. Both roles are updated jointly, so training pressure co-evolves with the model. On industrial, clinical, and legal multi-step causal reasoning benchmarks, CoEvo enables an 8B LLM to sustain self-evolution, surpassing distillation baselines and the strongest proprietary reference on path correctness (82.1% vs. 71.4%). The trained model generalizes to unseen categories and systems, preserving root-cause accuracy.

中文摘要：多步因果推理需要逐步约束的推理链，早期错误会静默传播，而通过错误逻辑得到的正确答案难以在结果层面被检测。在专业领域中，教师LLM在中间步骤会出错，安全约束限制云端蒸馏，条件变化要求适应，因此自演化成为可行路径。朴素自演化可能崩溃：仅结果奖励使模型利用分布捷径，弱自评估将虚假路径强化为稳定失败模式。作者利用一个关键不对称性：生成正确链很难，但验证单步很容易。许多高风险领域存在确定性、可查询的oracle（如物理模拟器或规则引擎），它无需教师级能力即可检查断言步骤，并在规则之外弃权。这促成了CoEvo框架，单个模型在Proposer和Solver之间交替。作为Solver，模型生成竞争链，组内辩论暴露分歧步骤（能力边界的代理），oracle将其裁决为过程级监督。作为Proposer，同一模型在oracle约束内构建逐渐更难的情景，引导课程走向深度多跳链。两个角色联合更新。在工业、临床和法律多步因果推理基准上，CoEvo使8B LLM持续自演化，在路径正确率上超越蒸馏基线和最强专有参考（82.1% vs. 71.4%）。

研究启发（模型推断）：该框架的oracle锚定过程监督思路可迁移至地理空间智能中的规则约束推理（如城市规划法规、遥感解译规则），但其摘要未涉及地理空间数据或城市更新场景，需自行验证跨域适用性。

相关度：62/100 该文提出基于可查询oracle的单模型自演化框架，通过Proposer与Solver角色交替实现多步因果推理的过程级监督，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向高度相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。

item.title: Coding Agents are Strong Prompt Optimizers
item.description:
中文标题：编码智能体是强大的提示优化器

作者：Agamdeep Singh, Srishti Gautam, Priyanshu Gupta, Nikita Mehrotra, Tanmay Bakshi, Sumit Gulwani

Abstract: Search-based prompt optimizers improve prompts through iterative search: they propose edits, execute fresh rollouts, score the resulting trajectories, and retain only edits that improve a validation metric. We show that this optimization loop is unnecessary. Given only a static corpus of agent trajectories, an off-the-shelf coding agent can directly synthesize an optimized prompt, requiring neither environment access nor validation data. We call this approach \textit{Coding-Agent Skill Distillation} (CASD). The key insight is reflection scope. Rather than reasoning over a small batch of trajectories at each optimization step, the coding agent writes and executes analysis code to compute corpus-wide statistics, identifies systematic failure modes, inspects representative episodes, and distills the resulting insights into behavioral rules. Across four agentic benchmarks (ALFWorld, $\tau^2$-bench retail and telecom, and SpreadsheetBench-Verified), under matched data access, a single CASD pass outperforms GEPA, a state-of-the-art reflective prompt optimizer, on three of four benchmarks and outperforms validation-gated reflective search (SkillOpt) on all four, improving the unoptimized baseline by 16.6 percentage points on average versus 10.9 for GEPA and 5.3 for SkillOpt. Because CASD performs a single offline analysis pass rather than iterative search, producing an optimized prompt costs approximately \$1.60---over $22\times$ cheaper than validation-gated search. Even when competing methods are granted additional validation data and unrestricted environment access, CASD remains ahead on two of four benchmarks. These results suggest that corpus-scale statistical reflection is a viable alternative to iterative search for prompt optimization.

中文摘要：基于搜索的提示优化器通过迭代搜索改进提示：提出编辑、执行新rollout、评分轨迹、仅保留改善验证指标的编辑。作者展示这一优化循环是不必要的。仅给定智能体轨迹的静态语料，现成的编码智能体可以直接合成优化提示，既不需要环境访问也不需要验证数据。作者称此方法为编码智能体技能蒸馏（CASD）。关键洞见是反思范围。编码智能体不是在每个优化步骤推理小批量轨迹，而是编写并执行分析代码以计算语料级统计、识别系统性失败模式、检查代表性片段，并将洞见蒸馏为行为规则。在四个智能体基准（ALFWorld、τ²-bench零售和电信、SpreadsheetBench-Verified）上，在匹配数据访问下，单次CASD通过优于最先进的反思提示优化器GEPA（四个基准中的三个），并优于验证门控反思搜索SkillOpt（全部四个），将未优化基线平均提升16.6个百分点，而GEPA为10.9，SkillOpt为5.3。由于CASD执行单次离线分析而非迭代搜索，生成优化提示的成本约为1.60美元——比验证门控搜索便宜22倍以上。即使竞争方法获得额外验证数据和无限制环境访问，CASD仍在四个基准中的两个上领先。

研究启发（模型推断）：语料级统计反思替代迭代搜索的思路可迁移至地理空间智能中的智能体工作流优化（如城市更新分析智能体的提示工程），但摘要未涉及地理空间任务，需自行验证。

相关度：58/100 该文提出编码智能体技能蒸馏（CASD）方法，利用编码智能体对轨迹语料进行离线分析以合成优化提示，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向高度相关，但未涉及地理空间应用。

item.title: RECAP: Relation Evidence Calibration for Detecting Spatial Relation Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
item.description:
中文标题：RECAP：用于检测视觉语言模型中空间关系幻觉的关系证据校准

作者：Feixiang Liu, Qiang Qiu, Qingyang Li, Hui Xu

Abstract: Vision-language models can answer spatial relation questions confidently even when the image supports an incompatible relation. We formulate relation-grounded selective prediction: accept or reject an already-produced yes/no answer by auditing its visual support, rather than treating uncertainty as evidence. RECAP, our relation-evidence calibration framework, compares image-conditioned likelihoods for a claim, its semantic contradictions, and optional one-sided supports, then converts these witnesses into an answer-conditioned rejection risk. A calibration-only gate preserves confidence as a veto when confidence is demonstrably informative and otherwise deploys relation evidence alone. Across 20 group/image-disjoint splits, RECAP lowers H-FPR@80 over confidence by between 2.0 and 17.9 points on VSR and raises Acc@80 by 3.0, 8.6, and 12.6 points on What'sUp for Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL3.5-8B, and LLaVA-1.5-7B. It outperforms matched VCD-style visual contrast on all four primary metrics in all six settings. Full-pool VSR fallback, target-ranked GSR-Bench transfer, equal-budget supervised controls, and two additional checkpoints show a consistent operating principle: structured counterevidence complements certainty when confidence is misaligned, while the gate retains confidence when it is already useful.

中文摘要：视觉语言模型即使图像支持的是不相容的关系，也可能自信地回答空间关系问题。作者提出“关系接地的选择性预测”：通过审查已生成的是/否答案的视觉支持来决定接受或拒绝，而不是把不确定性本身当作证据。RECAP框架比较某个断言、其语义矛盾以及可选单侧支持在图像条件下的似然，并将这些证据转化为以答案为条件的拒绝风险。一个仅做校准的门控在置信度确实有信息量时保留其否决作用，否则仅使用关系证据。在20个组/图像不相交的划分上，RECAP在VSR上将H-FPR@80较置信度降低2.0至17.9个百分点，并在What'sUp上对Qwen3-VL-8B、InternVL3.5-8B和LLaVA-1.5-7B分别将Acc@80提高3.0、8.6和12.6个百分点。在全部六种设置下，它在四项主要指标上均优于匹配的VCD式视觉对比。全池VSR回退、目标排序的GSR-Bench迁移、等预算监督对照以及另外两个检查点显示出一致的工作原则：当置信度失准时，结构化反证据可补充确定性；而当置信度已有用时，门控会保留置信度。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作提示，在空间关系判断中引入结构化反证据可作为置信度校准的补充手段；对地理空间智能中依赖VLM进行空间推理的场景，可能提供一种拒绝不可靠空间断言的思路，但其结论限于所测基准与模型。

相关度：62/100 该文研究视觉语言模型中的空间关系幻觉检测与关系证据校准，与LLM/多智能体及地理空间智能方向相关，但其核心是模型可信度校准而非地理空间分析，与城市更新或遥感变化检测的直接关联有限。

中文摘要：视觉语言模型即使图像支持的是不相容的关系，也可能自信地回答空间关系问题。作者提出“关系接地的选择性预测”：通过审查已生成的是/否答案的视觉支持来决定接受或拒绝，而不是把不确定性本身当作证据。RECAP框架比较某个断言、其语义矛盾以及可选单侧支持在图像条件下的似然，并将这些证据转化为以答案为条件的拒绝风险。一个仅做校准的门控在置信度确实有信息量时保留其否决作用，否则仅使用关系证据。在20个组/图像不相交的划分上，RECAP在VSR上将H-FPR@80较置信度降低2.0至17.9个百分点，并在What'sUp上对Qwen3-VL-8B、InternVL3.5-8B和LLaVA-1.5-7B分别将Acc@80提高3.0、8.6和12.6个百分点。在全部六种设置下，它在四项主要指标上均优于匹配的VCD式视觉对比。全池VSR回退、目标排序的GSR-Bench迁移、等预算监督对照以及另外两个检查点显示出一致的工作原则：当置信度失准时，结构化反证据可补充确定性；而当置信度已有用时，门控会保留置信度。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作提示，在空间关系判断中引入结构化反证据可作为置信度校准的补充手段；对地理空间智能中依赖VLM进行空间推理的场景，可能提供一种拒绝不可靠空间断言的思路，但其结论限于所测基准与模型。

相关度：62/100 该文研究视觉语言模型中的空间关系幻觉检测与关系证据校准，与LLM/多智能体及地理空间智能方向相关，但其核心是模型可信度校准而非地理空间分析，与城市更新或遥感变化检测的直接关联有限。

item.title: Do Synthetic Personas Predict Real Audience Response? A Sim-to-Real Study Where a No-Persona Baseline Beats Persona-Based Copy Simulation
item.description:
中文标题：合成人物能预测真实受众反应吗？一项无人物基线优于基于人物的文案模拟的模拟到现实研究

作者：Alexandre Cristov\~ao Maiorano

Abstract: Marketers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) as "synthetic personas" to predict how an audience will react to a piece of copy before it ships, encouraged by evidence that profile-conditioned LLMs mimic human samples. But is that prediction actually valid against real behaviour - and does the persona machinery help? We present a sim-to-real validity study using the Upworthy Research Archive - thousands of headline A/B tests on shared real traffic, with measured click-through - as held-out ground truth. We compare a ten-persona panel, grounded in the real audience's demographics, against a no-persona zero-shot baseline that simply asks the model how likely a typical reader is to click. Two findings stand out. First, ground-truth reliability is the binding constraint: most A/B tests have no statistically distinguishable winner, so validity can only be measured on the reliable subset (n = 399). Second, and counter to the persona-simulation premise, persona conditioning degrades predictive validity: the no-persona baseline ranks variants markedly better (Kendall {\tau} = 0.361, a medium effect; top-1 accuracy 49.2%) than the persona panel ({\tau} = 0.084; top-1 34.6%), with non-overlapping confidence intervals. Asking the model directly taps an accurate population-level prior; forcing it to role-play specific personas injects bias and noise. The result replicates across three independent Upworthy splits, holds in direction on a different-domain news dataset, and is robust to seed, prompt phrasing, and model choice - across three Gemini tiers and a different model family (OpenAI gpt-4.1, significant paired gap). The takeaway: for predicting aggregate engagement, a plain LLM ranker beats persona simulation - synthetic personas are not merely a weak predictor, they are worse than not using them. All numbers regenerate from a public, artifact-first replication package.

中文摘要：营销人员越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLM）作为“合成人物”，在文案发布前预测受众反应，这受到有证据表明基于画像条件的LLM能模仿人类样本的鼓励。但这种预测对真实行为是否真正有效——人物机制是否有帮助？我们提出一项模拟到现实效度研究，使用Upworthy研究档案——数千个在共享真实流量上进行的标题A/B测试，并测量点击率——作为留出的真实基准。我们将一个基于真实受众人口统计特征的十人物小组，与一个无人物零样本基线进行比较，后者只是询问模型典型读者点击的可能性。两个发现尤为突出。第一，真实基准的可靠性是约束瓶颈：大多数A/B测试没有统计上可区分的胜者，因此效度只能在可靠子集（n = 399）上测量。第二，与人物模拟前提相反，人物条件化降低了预测效度：无人物基线对变体的排序明显更好（Kendall τ = 0.361，中等效应；top-1准确率49.2%），优于人物小组（τ = 0.084；top-1 34.6%），且置信区间不重叠。直接询问模型利用了准确的群体层面先验；强迫其扮演特定人物会注入偏差和噪声。该结果在三个独立的Upworthy划分上复现，在另一个领域的新闻数据集上方向一致，并且对随机种子、提示措辞和模型选择稳健——涵盖三个Gemini层级和另一个模型家族（OpenAI gpt-4.1，配对差距显著）。结论：对于预测总体参与度，普通LLM排序器优于人物模拟——合成人物不仅是弱预测器，它们……

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究提示，在利用LLM模拟人类行为时，直接询问群体层面先验可能优于强制角色扮演，这对基于LLM代理的城市模拟或多智能体行为预测具有方法学参考价值。

相关度：62/100 该研究检验LLM合成人物对真实受众反应的预测效度，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但其应用场景为营销文案点击预测，而非城市更新或地理空间分析。

item.title: BixBench3: Benchmarking AI agents on research-study-scale computational biology tasks
item.description:
中文标题：BixBench3：在研究规模的计算生物学任务上对AI智能体进行基准测试

作者：Zane Koch, Asmamaw T. Wassie, Javier Valdes-Aleman, Jason Lee, Michaela M. Hinks, Samuel G. Rodriques, Andrew D. White, Jon M. Laurent

Abstract: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

中文摘要：本文介绍了BixBench3，一个衡量AI智能体处理原始生物数据直至产生科学结果能力的基准。任务模拟科学家将工作委托给智能体的过程，智能体需根据研究目标和原始数据执行一系列分析。通过对20个任务、138个数据产物的评估，发现13个前沿模型得分从0.00到0.48不等，且模型在数据量更大、步骤更多的任务上表现更差。

研究启发（模型推断）：LLM智能体在完成多步骤、大数据量的复杂研究任务时能力有限，且性能与成本并非正相关，高效能的智能体可能更便宜。

相关度：60/100 该论文提出了一个用于评估AI智能体在计算生物学任务中能力的基准，与LLM和多智能体研究方向相关，但领域为生物学而非城市或地理信息。

item.title: Mitigating Identity Essentialism in LLM Agents with Longitudinal Life Trajectories
item.description:
中文标题：利用纵向生命轨迹缓解LLM智能体中的身份本质主义

作者：Hexi Wang, Yujia Zhou, Bangde Du, Weihang Su, Xinyuan Cao, Qingyi Pan, Qingyao Ai, Yueyue Wu, Min Zhang, Yiqun Liu

Abstract: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

中文摘要：发现静态画像的LLM智能体在模拟中表现出比人类更强的群体分离和组内同质化，即身份本质主义。为此提出LifeMem纵向记忆框架，结合结构化生活事件检索和智能体特定参数记忆。实验表明，LifeMem能提升智能体与人类数据在响应分布、多样性和个体变化模式上的一致性。

研究启发（模型推断）：在构建城市人口或社区模拟智能体时，引入纵向的生活事件记忆而非仅依赖静态人口统计特征，能更真实地模拟个体行为的多样性和动态变化。

item.title: BackTrend: Evaluating Scientific Weak-Signal Prediction via Backward Reconstruction
item.description:
中文标题：BackTrend：通过反向重建评估科学弱信号预测

作者：Xiao Zhou, Yilun Zhao, Owen Jiang, Tiansheng Hu, Cai Xu, Manasi Patwardhan, Arman Cohan

Abstract: Scientific weak signals are early, low-visibility research directions that later become central to mature scientific topics, yet existing resources such as trend tracking, citation forecasting, and foresight reports rarely provide validated reference sets that link concrete early precursors to later paradigms. We introduce BackTrend, a retrospective benchmark in which, given a mature target topic and a temporal evidence constraint, systems must recover two types of precursors: problem-space signals, underrecognized research problems, and solution-space signals, emerging methods for known problems. BackTrend contains 25 mature target topics in artificial intelligence and machine learning and 66 human-validated weak signals, reconstructed from large-scale literature by grounding each candidate in its 2019-2024 publication-frequency trajectory. We evaluate frontier LLMs, RAG systems, and agentic research systems using semantic matching and coverage-based metrics. Current systems often generate plausible but misaligned precursors, exhibiting topic drift, granularity mismatch, near-miss matching, and incomplete coverage; the strongest system achieves only 10.1% F1, while Coverage10 reaches at most 18.5% of the reference signals. Our budget analyses show that additional retrieval and web-search evidence can improve performance up to a moderate budget, but does not by itself close the substantial performance gap.

中文摘要：科学弱信号是早期、低可见度但后来成为成熟科学主题核心的研究方向，然而趋势追踪、引用预测和前瞻报告等现有资源很少提供将具体早期前兆与后期范式联系起来的经过验证的参考集。我们提出BackTrend，一个回顾性基准：给定一个成熟目标主题和时间证据约束，系统必须恢复两类前兆——问题空间信号（未被充分认识的研究问题）和解决方案空间信号（针对已知问题的新兴方法）。BackTrend包含人工智能和机器学习领域的25个成熟目标主题和66个经人工验证的弱信号，通过将每个候选信号锚定在其2019—2024年发表频率轨迹上，从大规模文献中重建。我们使用语义匹配和基于覆盖率的指标评估前沿LLM、RAG系统和智能体研究系统。当前系统往往生成看似合理但错位的前兆，表现出主题漂移、粒度不匹配、近似匹配和不完整覆盖；最强系统仅达到10.1%的F1，Coverage10最多达到参考信号的18.5%。我们的预算分析表明，额外的检索和网络搜索证据可在中等预算内提升性能，但本身无法弥合巨大的性能差距。

研究启发（模型推断）：该基准揭示了当前LLM与智能体系统在识别科学弱信号方面仍存在显著不足，提示在时空数据挖掘与文献趋势分析中，单纯增加检索预算不足以解决语义错位与覆盖不全问题。

相关度：62/100 该文构建了科学弱信号预测的回顾性基准，评估LLM、RAG与智能体研究系统，与时空数据挖掘中的趋势识别和LLM/多智能体研究兴趣相关，但未涉及地理空间数据或城市更新。

item.title: SocioVerse2: A Longitudinal Dynamic Social Simulation Framework under a Human-AI Co-evolutionary Paradigm
item.description:
中文标题：SocioVerse2：人机协同演化范式下的纵向动态社会模拟框架

作者：Xinnong Zhang, Jiayu Lin, Jia Wang, Yixu Huang, Xinyi Mou, Yingqian Wu, Jingcong Liang, Shijun Lei, Jianing Shi, Guanying Li, Siyuan Wang, Hanjia Lyu, Zhenfei Yin, Yunlu Yin, Siming Chen, Yulan He, Jiebo Luo, Xuanjing Huang, Liyin Jin, Baohua Zhou, Hanqi Yan, Zhongyu Wei

Abstract: Social simulation offers the social sciences an experimental instrument that the real world cannot supply, and generative agents have transformed it by acting as silicon samples that unite agent-based modeling with real behavioral data. Existing platforms verify collective behavior, align simulated populations with real societies in cross-sections, and employ autonomous agents for the research process. However, two social science requirements remain without systematic support: intervention in the content of a simulation and the researcher's control over the process that produces it. We present SocioVerse2, which extends SocioVerse 1.0 into a human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm built from two loops and one infrastructure. The longitudinal simulation loop simulates the target population with evolving environments and forks counterfactual branches via interventions. The controllable research loop takes the study itself as an editable state and updates state versions via controllable editing. The social science agentic infrastructure carries both loops through composable skills with researcher checkpoints, a population service over five persona pools, and an environment service over 21 real-world signal sources with point-in-time guarantees. We validate SocioVerse2 across three case families and seven case studies, from reproducing canonical agent-based models to modeling policy processes on real records and nowcasting macro-economic indices beyond the response model's knowledge cutoff. With the human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm, these cases go beyond system demonstrations to become substantive studies that investigate frontier questions in their respective disciplines. Code, data services, and a workbench are released as open-source resources.

中文摘要：社会模拟为社会科学提供了一种现实世界无法提供的实验工具，而生成式智能体通过充当连接基于智能体建模与真实行为数据的“硅样本”改变了这一领域。现有平台验证集体行为、在横截面上使模拟人群与真实社会对齐，并采用自主智能体进行研究过程。然而，社会科学的两项需求仍缺乏系统性支持：对模拟内容的干预以及研究者对产生模拟过程的控制。我们提出SocioVerse2，将SocioVerse 1.0扩展为人机协同演化范式，由两个循环和一个基础设施构成。纵向模拟循环通过演化环境和干预分叉反事实分支来模拟目标人群。可控研究循环将研究本身视为可编辑状态，并通过可控编辑更新状态版本。社会科学智能体基础设施通过带研究者检查点的可组合技能、覆盖五个角色池的人群服务，以及覆盖21个真实世界信号源并具有时点保证的环境服务来承载这两个循环。我们在三个案例族和七个案例研究中验证SocioVerse2，从复现经典基于智能体模型到基于真实记录建模政策过程，再到对超出响应模型知识截止点的宏观经济指标进行临近预测。借助人机协同演化范式，这些案例超越系统演示，成为探究各自学科前沿问题的实质性研究。代码、数据服务和工作台已作为开源资源发布。

研究启发（模型推断）：该框架将反事实干预与研究者可控流程结合，为城市更新等社会空间过程的模拟实验提供了可借鉴的人机协同与纵向动态建模范式。

相关度：78/100 该文提出纵向动态社会模拟框架，支持反事实干预与可控研究流程，与LLM和多智能体、时空数据挖掘及城市更新模拟研究高度相关。

With the human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm, these cases go beyond system demonstrations to become substantive studies that investigate frontier questions in their respective disciplines. Code, data services, and a workbench are released as open-source resources.

中文摘要：社会模拟为社会科学提供了一种现实世界无法提供的实验工具，而生成式智能体通过充当连接基于智能体建模与真实行为数据的“硅样本”改变了这一领域。现有平台验证集体行为、在横截面上使模拟人群与真实社会对齐，并采用自主智能体进行研究过程。然而，社会科学的两项需求仍缺乏系统性支持：对模拟内容的干预以及研究者对产生模拟过程的控制。我们提出SocioVerse2，将SocioVerse 1.0扩展为人机协同演化范式，由两个循环和一个基础设施构成。纵向模拟循环通过演化环境和干预分叉反事实分支来模拟目标人群。可控研究循环将研究本身视为可编辑状态，并通过可控编辑更新状态版本。社会科学智能体基础设施通过带研究者检查点的可组合技能、覆盖五个角色池的人群服务，以及覆盖21个真实世界信号源并具有时点保证的环境服务来承载这两个循环。我们在三个案例族和七个案例研究中验证SocioVerse2，从复现经典基于智能体模型到基于真实记录建模政策过程，再到对超出响应模型知识截止点的宏观经济指标进行临近预测。借助人机协同演化范式，这些案例超越系统演示，成为探究各自学科前沿问题的实质性研究。代码、数据服务和工作台已作为开源资源发布。

研究启发（模型推断）：该框架将反事实干预与研究者可控流程结合，为城市更新等社会空间过程的模拟实验提供了可借鉴的人机协同与纵向动态建模范式。

item.title: TimeLitmus: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Cross-Modal Understanding and Explanation Faithfulness in Event-Conditioned Time-Series Prediction
item.description:
中文标题：TimeLitmus：事件条件下时间序列预测中跨模态理解与解释忠实性的诊断基准

作者：Jie Gong, Maowei Jiang, Zhiwei Liu, Yankai Chen, Guojun Xiong, Xue Liu, Min Peng, Qianqian Xie, and Sophia Ananiadou

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make predictions from numerical time-series histories and textual events. Yet accuracy alone cannot reveal whether correct answers reflect effective integration of the two inputs or instead arise from event polarity, unimodal priors, or superficial cues. Likewise, plausible explanations may rationalize predictions without faithfully reflecting the evidence that drives model behavior. We introduce TimeLitmus, a diagnostic benchmark for cross-modal understanding and explanation faithfulness in event-conditioned time-series prediction. TimeLitmus contains 4,856 evaluation records across Finance and Traffic, combining natural prediction with controlled counterfactual and contrastive interventions, explanation-targeted faithfulness tests, and systematic shortcut controls. Across ten representative LLMs, standard prediction accuracy substantially overstates reliable cross-modal understanding: Hard Paired Contrast (HPC) pair correctness peaks at only 19.2% in Finance and 11.7% in Traffic, and all ten models show lower-than-expected consistency on Finance series-side controls. Models often recognize scenario relations explicitly yet fail to apply them during independent prediction. Explanation faithfulness shows a similar gap: in Traffic, most models cite the manipulated temporal factor in over 90% of cases, while behavioral support remains below 22%. Human annotators outperform LLMs on matched controlled and hard-pair diagnostics, confirming that these distinctions are recoverable from the inputs. Natural-only adaptation yields selective gains in evidence selection and input sensitivity, but not consistent gains in controlled or hard-pair behavior. The benchmark, evaluation suite, and supervised adaptation data will be released publicly.

中文摘要：大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于从数值时间序列历史和文本事件中进行预测。然而，仅凭准确率无法揭示正确答案是源于对两种输入的有效整合，还是来自事件极性、单模态先验或表面线索。同样，看似合理的解释可能只是为预测提供合理化说辞，而并未忠实反映驱动模型行为的证据。我们提出TimeLitmus，一个用于事件条件下时间序列预测中跨模态理解与解释忠实性的诊断基准。TimeLitmus包含金融和交通领域的4,856条评估记录，结合了自然预测与受控反事实和对比干预、面向解释的忠实性测试以及系统性捷径控制。在十个代表性LLM上，标准预测准确率大幅高估了可靠的跨模态理解：困难配对对比（HPC）配对正确率在金融领域最高仅为19.2%，在交通领域为11.7%，且十个模型在金融序列侧控制上均表现出低于预期的一致性。模型往往能明确识别场景关系，却在独立预测时无法应用这些关系。解释忠实性也呈现类似差距：在交通领域，大多数模型在超过90%的情况下引用了被操纵的时间因素，而行为支持率仍低于22%。人类标注者在匹配的受控和困难配对诊断上优于LLM，证实这些区分可从输入中恢复。仅自然数据的适配在证据选择和输入敏感性方面带来选择性提升，但在受控或困难配对行为上没有一致增益。该基准、评估套件和监督适配数据将被发布。

研究启发（模型推断）：该基准揭示了LLM在事件条件下时间序列预测中准确率与真实跨模态理解之间的显著差距，提示在时空数据挖掘中应用LLM时需警惕表面线索和解释不忠实问题。

相关度：62/100 该论文关注LLM在事件条件下的时间序列预测中的跨模态理解与解释忠实性，与研究中LLM、时空数据挖掘及多智能体方向有一定关联，但未涉及城市更新或遥感变化检测。

item.title: Dynamic Thermal Gaussians: Multimodal 4D Gaussian Splatting
item.description:
中文标题：动态热高斯：多模态4D高斯泼溅

作者：Rongfeng Lu, Lifeng Lin, Xiaobao Wei, Quan Chen, Ming Lu, Yitian Xue, Yaoqi Sun, Yuhan Gao, Anke Xue, Chenggang Yan

Abstract: Thermography plays a vital role in military and broader thermal analysis applications. Recent progress in 3D thermal reconstruction has extended temperature analysis from 2D to 3D space, yet most existing works assume static temperature distributions, neglecting the temporal dynamics of heat transfer in real-world environments. To address this limitation, we propose the first dynamic RGB-Thermal reconstruction framework for complex scenes. Our method jointly models RGB appearance, thermal observations, and scene geometry as they change over time. Specifically, we introduce a multimodal dynamic scene representation that anchors both the color and thermal modalities to a shared geometric substrate, ensuring their consistency under spatiotemporal deformations. We further design multimodal embeddings to enhance the motion expressiveness for each modality, and propose a multimodal routing mechanism that retains a unified set of shared multimodal Gaussians as the geometric backbone while adaptively spawning modality-specific Gaussians to strengthen the representational capacity in detail-rich regions of each individual modality. In addition, we contribute a novel benchmark dataset featuring high-frequency temperature variations to facilitate the evaluation of 4D reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity spatiotemporal reconstruction of both appearance and temperature. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/LinLif1869/DTG.

中文摘要：热成像在军事及更广泛的热分析应用中至关重要。近期三维热重建的进展将温度分析从二维扩展到三维空间，但多数现有工作假设温度分布是静态的，忽略了真实环境中热传递的时间动态。为解决这一局限，作者提出首个面向复杂场景的动态RGB-热红外重建框架。该方法联合建模随时间变化的RGB外观、热观测与场景几何。具体而言，作者引入多模态动态场景表示，将颜色与热模态锚定到共享几何基底，确保其在时空形变下的一致性；进一步设计多模态嵌入以增强各模态的运动表达能力，并提出多模态路由机制，在保留统一共享多模态高斯作为几何主干的同时，自适应生成模态特定的高斯以增强各模态细节丰富区域的表示能力。此外，作者贡献了一个具有高频温度变化的新基准数据集以支持4D重建评估。大量实验表明该方法实现了外观与温度的高保真时空重建。代码与数据集已公开。

研究启发（模型推断）：共享几何基底加模态特定高斯的表示思路，可能为多源遥感数据（如光学与热红外）的时空一致性融合提供借鉴；其高频温度变化基准也提示热动态建模需要专门的时序数据支撑。

相关度：62/100 该文提出动态RGB-热红外4D高斯泼溅重建框架，将颜色与热模态锚定到共享几何基底并建模时空形变，与多源数据融合和遥感变化检测中的时空建模思路相关，但应用场景为通用复杂场景而非城市/遥感，故相关性中等。

item.title: High-Dimensional Online Change Point Detection with Adaptive Thresholding and Interpretability
item.description:
中文标题：高维在线变化点检测：自适应阈值与可解释性

作者：Sven Jacob, Bardh Prenkaj, Weijia Shao, Gjergji Kasneci

Abstract: Change point detection (CPD) identifies abrupt and significant changes in sequential data, with applications in human activity recognition, financial markets, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and autonomous systems. Traditional CPD methods often face computational challenges in high-dimensional settings and typically provide limited explanations for detected changes, which can restrict their practical usability. This paper introduces a CPD framework that improves scalability and interpretability by leveraging the Sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance. Our contributions are fourfold: (1) we transform multivariate sequential data into one-dimensional scores using the SW distance, making the resulting representation compatible with existing CPD methods; (2) we analyze the distributional behavior of random slices of the SW distance and show that, under suitable assumptions, they can be approximated by a Gamma distribution, providing a principled basis for threshold calibration; (3) we propose a self-adapting online CPD algorithm that combines this SW-based score with an adaptive quantile-based threshold; (4) we introduce a model-specific framework for generating contrastive explanations for annotated change points. Empirically, our method reduces false positives by at least $48\%$ on average compared with popular online and offline CPD baselines, while maintaining competitive or superior detection performance. Code is available at https://github.com/jsve96/SWCPD_Code. At the same time, it produces interpretable change-point annotations, making it practical for deployment in high-stakes applications.

中文摘要：变化点检测（CPD）用于识别序列数据中的突变，应用于人类活动识别、金融市场、网络安全、制造与自主系统。传统方法在高维场景下计算困难且解释性有限。本文提出基于Sliced Wasserstein（SW）距离的CPD框架，贡献包括：(1) 用SW距离将多变量序列转为一维得分，兼容现有CPD方法；(2) 分析SW随机切片的分布行为，在适当假设下可用Gamma分布近似，为阈值标定提供依据；(3) 提出结合SW得分与自适应分位数阈值的自适在线CPD算法；(4) 提出针对标注变化点的对比解释生成框架。实验显示，相比主流在线与离线基线，该方法平均减少至少48%的误报，同时保持相当或更优的检测性能，并产生可解释的变化点标注。

研究启发（模型推断）：该框架的SW降维+自适应分位数阈值思路可迁移到城市时空监测与遥感时序变化检测中，用于降低高维误报；其对比解释机制也有助于变化检测结果的可解释呈现，但摘要未验证地理空间数据。

相关度：78/100 高维在线变化点检测与时空数据挖掘、遥感变化检测在方法层面高度相关，其自适应阈值与可解释性框架可迁移至时空序列与遥感时序分析。

相关度：78/100 高维在线变化点检测与时空数据挖掘、遥感变化检测在方法层面高度相关，其自适应阈值与可解释性框架可迁移至时空序列与遥感时序分析。

item.title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
item.description:
中文标题：ACLArena：多阶段后训练中的智能体持续学习

作者：Haixin Wang, Xiaoxuan Wang, Junkai Zhang, Han Zhang, Renliang Sun, Alexander K Taylor, Yidan Shi, Haoran Deng, Chenguang Wang, Jason Cong, Yizhou Sun, Wei Wang

Abstract: Building general-purpose agents for industrial deployment requires integrating multiple capabilities, each typically acquired at a distinct stage of training. Yet there is currently no well-established recipe for Agent Continual Learning (ACL), with little understanding of the trade-offs among existing integration paradigms. To address this gap, we introduce ACLArena, a framework for comprehensively studying, analyzing, and evaluating ACL. We first build a sequential training pipeline and conduct an in-depth analysis that explains the mechanisms of forgetting and generalization from two complementary perspectives, the model level and the token level. Guided by these analyses, we systematically compare multi-teacher on-policy distillation, self-distilled fine-tuning, and model merging to assess their ability to recover previously learned capabilities while preserving newly acquired ones. Through extensive experiments, we develop a detailed understanding of how capabilities transfer across stages. Finally, we propose a new ACL recipe that combines offline replay over high-quality trajectories with a routed network of multiple LoRA experts each specialized via RL, substantially improving the agent's ability to learn across multiple domains. Comprehensive experiments on four reasoning and agentic tasks, evaluated under both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, demonstrate the value of our analysis and the effectiveness of our approach.

中文摘要：构建通用工业部署智能体需要整合多种能力，而这些能力通常在不同训练阶段获得。然而目前尚无成熟的智能体持续学习（ACL）方案，对现有整合范式之间的权衡也缺乏理解。为填补这一空白，作者提出ACLArena框架，用于全面研究、分析和评估ACL。他们首先构建顺序训练流水线，并从模型层面和token层面两个互补视角深入分析遗忘与泛化的机制。在这些分析指导下，系统比较了多教师在线策略蒸馏、自蒸馏微调和模型合并三种方法在恢复旧能力同时保持新能力方面的表现。通过大量实验，深入理解了能力如何跨阶段迁移。最后提出一种新的ACL方案，结合高质量轨迹的离线回放与多个经RL专门化的LoRA专家路由网络，显著提升智能体跨多领域学习能力。在四个推理和智能体任务上的域内和域外综合实验验证了分析的价值和方法的有效性。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作为智能体持续学习提供了系统性的分析框架和评估基准，其多LoRA专家路由与离线回放结合的方案可能为多智能体系统中能力整合提供参考，但需注意其应用场景为通用推理与智能体任务，未涉及地理空间领域。

相关度：62/100 该论文研究智能体持续学习（ACL）与多阶段后训练，涉及多教师蒸馏、LoRA专家路由等，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。

item.title: MotionJEPA: Preventing Temporal Feature Collapse by Capturing Visual Changes in Latent Space
item.description:
中文标题：MotionJEPA：通过在潜在空间中捕捉视觉变化防止时序特征坍缩

作者：Markus Karmann, Shile Li, Christian Intern\`o, Bruno Andreis, David Klindt, Randall Balestriero, Jindong Gu, Philip Torr, Qi Zhang, Peng-Tao Jiang, Hao Zhang, Bo Li, Onay Urfalioglu

Abstract: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are a promising paradigm for learning task-agnostic latent world models without visual reconstruction. However, standard JEPA training exhibits a strong inductive bias towards slow features, causing feature suppression and the collapse of latent representation. While inverse dynamics provides temporal anti-collapse, it relies on action labels and offers little incentive to embed general, unlabeled dynamics. We introduce Difference Image and Single image embedding Regularization (DISReg), a novel regularizer that builds on an inverse-dynamics-style module that predicts temporal difference image embeddings without any pixel reconstruction loss, encouraging balanced static and dynamic feature learning. DISReg consists of a static term that shapes the distribution of the image embedding and encourages slow features, and a dynamic term, which, unlike direct regularization on the embedding, imposes no constraint on the image embedding's shape or distribution and instead only incentivizes that dynamic features be present. By integrating this regularizer into a standard JEPA, we establish our new architecture, MotionJEPA. Latent probing demonstrates that MotionJEPA produces more complete representations than other methods, and our trajectory analysis shows it maintains geometrically simple latent embeddings with low curvature. We further show that MotionJEPA improves downstream planning success under static-background distractors across four environments.

中文摘要：联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）是一种无需视觉重建即可学习任务无关潜在世界模型的有前景范式。然而，标准JEPA训练对慢特征存在强归纳偏置，导致特征抑制和潜在表征坍缩。逆动力学虽提供时序抗坍缩能力，但依赖动作标签，且对嵌入通用的无标签动态缺乏激励。本文提出差异图像与单图像嵌入正则化（DISReg），一种基于逆动力学风格模块的新型正则化器，可在无任何像素重建损失的情况下预测时序差异图像嵌入，鼓励静态与动态特征的平衡学习。DISReg包含静态项（塑造图像嵌入分布并鼓励慢特征）和动态项（不同于对嵌入的直接正则化，不对图像嵌入的形状或分布施加约束，仅激励动态特征的存在）。将该正则化器集成到标准JEPA中，构建了新架构MotionJEPA。潜在探测表明MotionJEPA产生比其他方法更完整的表征，轨迹分析显示其保持几何简单、低曲率的潜在嵌入。进一步表明MotionJEPA在四个环境中提升了静态背景干扰下的下游规划成功率。

研究启发（模型推断）：该文的时序差异嵌入正则化思路可迁移至遥感变化检测中的双时相特征学习，有助于缓解变化信号被静态背景淹没的问题；但其验证环境为通用视觉任务，向地理空间场景的适用性尚需进一步检验。

相关度：62/100 该文提出MotionJEPA，通过差异图像与单图像嵌入正则化防止时序特征坍缩，核心在于潜在空间中捕捉视觉变化，与遥感变化检测和时空数据挖掘在方法论上高度相关，但未涉及地理空间数据或城市应用。

item.title: From UNDRR Reports to Event Records: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction of Georeferenced Disasters
item.description:
中文标题：从UNDRR报告到事件记录：地理参考灾害的模式约束LLM抽取

作者：Camilla Andreozzi, Phuong-Anh Nguyen-Le, Zhijing Jin, Revati Mani

Abstract: Disaster-risk-reduction archives describe hazard events in prose that databases such as EM-DAT (Delforge et al., 2025) cannot ingest directly. We present an LLM pipeline that generates candidate georeferenced event records using a controlled hazard vocabulary and fixed schema, retaining evidence for review. Applied to 10,000 documents from PreventionWeb, the knowledge hub managed by UNDRR, it produced 3,572 records from 1,913 documents across 24 hazard types and resolved 81% of location mentions to OpenStreetMap geometries. On 171 human-positive document windows from a stratified 217-document reference set, GPT-5 achieved 86.0% pooled attribute $F_1$, versus 44.2% for the spaCy-gazetteer baseline. Evaluation pools hazard families, location strings, and event years within documents, without assessing their assignment to individual events. GPT-5.4 ranked highest among ten LLMs (86.6% $F_1$). Verbatim evidence occurrence was 72.0% for GPT-5 and 47.2% for GPT-5.4, measuring textual traceability without establishing attribute support. We report production failure modes and automated label and location-rule compliance checks. Prompts, schema, and outputs will be released for adaptation to national reporting archives.

中文摘要：灾害风险减少档案以散文形式描述灾害事件，EM-DAT等数据库无法直接摄取。本文提出一个LLM流程，使用受控灾害词汇表和固定模式生成候选地理参考事件记录，并保留证据以供审查。应用于UNDRR管理的知识中心PreventionWeb的10,000份文档，从1,913份文档中生成3,572条记录，涵盖24种灾害类型，并将81%的位置提及解析为OpenStreetMap几何。在分层217份文档参考集中171个人工正例文档窗口上，GPT-5达到86.0%的汇总属性F_1，而spaCy-gazetteer基线为44.2%。评估在文档内汇总灾害家族、位置字符串和事件年份，未评估其到单个事件的分配。GPT-5.4在十个LLM中排名最高（86.6% F_1）。GPT-5的逐字证据出现率为72.0%，GPT-5.4为47.2%，衡量文本可追溯性但未确立属性支持。报告了生产故障模式及自动化标签和位置规则合规检查。提示、模式及输出将发布以供适配国家报告档案。

研究启发（模型推断）：该文的模式约束LLM抽取+地理编码流程可直接启发城市更新研究中从政策文本或规划报告中抽取地理参考事件记录；其证据保留和合规检查机制对构建可审查的时空知识库具有参考价值，但需注意其评估未涉及事件级分配精度。

相关度：78/100 该文利用LLM从UNDRR报告中抽取地理参考灾害事件记录，涉及地理编码、模式约束抽取和地理空间数据构建，与地理空间智能和多源数据融合高度相关，且灾害事件时空数据挖掘与城市更新研究中的时空数据挖掘方法论相通。

item.title: PosEviLoc: Position-Conditioned Spatial Evidence for Language-Based 3D Localization
item.description:
中文标题：PosEviLoc：面向基于语言的三维定位的位置条件化空间证据

作者：Tianyi Shang, Yike Shi, Zhenyu Li

Abstract: Language-based 3D localization retrieves the point-cloud submap containing a target position from descriptions of nearby objects and their spatial relations. Existing methods typically compress queries and submaps into global descriptors, potentially obscuring object-level semantics and cross-description spatial coherence. We propose Position-Conditioned Evidence Localization (PosEviLoc), a query-position-aware framework for coarse text-to-point-cloud localization. Instead of relying on global matching, PosEviLoc evaluates each candidate submap using explicit semantic and spatial evidence. It models direction as a relation jointly determined by an object position and a hypothetical query position. The resulting Query-Position Spatial Evidence Field (QSEF) measures the fraction of query descriptions supported at each hypothetical position, explicitly capturing their agreement without using the ground-truth query pose to construct the evidence field. A Multi-Level Evidence Readout (MER) summarizes this evidence in a compact representation, which a lightweight MLP converts into a retrieval score. Across five benchmarks, PosEviLoc outperforms MNCL by an average of 17 percentage points in Recall@1. When used as a plug-and-play reranker, it improves MNCL by an average of 16 percentage points. Moreover, PosEviLoc introduces substantially fewer parameters and achieves faster inference speed than existing methods.

中文摘要：基于语言的三维定位旨在根据对附近物体及其空间关系的描述，检索包含目标位置的点云子图。现有方法通常将查询和子图压缩为全局描述符，可能掩盖物体级语义和跨描述的空间一致性。本文提出位置条件化证据定位（PosEviLoc），一种面向查询位置感知的粗粒度文本到点云定位框架。PosEviLoc不依赖全局匹配，而是使用显式语义和空间证据评估每个候选子图。它将方向建模为由物体位置和假设查询位置共同决定的关系。由此得到的查询-位置空间证据场（QSEF）衡量每个假设位置支持的查询描述比例，在不使用真实查询位姿构建证据场的情况下显式捕捉其一致性。多级证据读出（MER）将证据总结为紧凑表示，再由轻量MLP转换为检索分数。在五个基准上，PosEviLoc在Recall@1上平均超过MNCL 17个百分点。作为即插即用重排序器时，平均提升MNCL 16个百分点。此外，PosEviLoc参数显著更少，推理速度更快。

中文标题：PosEviLoc：面向基于语言的三维定位的位置条件化空间证据

作者：Tianyi Shang, Yike Shi, Zhenyu Li

Abstract: Language-based 3D localization retrieves the point-cloud submap containing a target position from descriptions of nearby objects and their spatial relations. Existing methods typically compress queries and submaps into global descriptors, potentially obscuring object-level semantics and cross-description spatial coherence. We propose Position-Conditioned Evidence Localization (PosEviLoc), a query-position-aware framework for coarse text-to-point-cloud localization. Instead of relying on global matching, PosEviLoc evaluates each candidate submap using explicit semantic and spatial evidence. It models direction as a relation jointly determined by an object position and a hypothetical query position. The resulting Query-Position Spatial Evidence Field (QSEF) measures the fraction of query descriptions supported at each hypothetical position, explicitly capturing their agreement without using the ground-truth query pose to construct the evidence field. A Multi-Level Evidence Readout (MER) summarizes this evidence in a compact representation, which a lightweight MLP converts into a retrieval score. Across five benchmarks, PosEviLoc outperforms MNCL by an average of 17 percentage points in Recall@1. When used as a plug-and-play reranker, it improves MNCL by an average of 16 percentage points. Moreover, PosEviLoc introduces substantially fewer parameters and achieves faster inference speed than existing methods.

item.title: ZIL: Zero-shot Image-to-LiDAR Registration
item.description:
中文标题：ZIL：零样本图像到LiDAR配准

作者：Zijun Li, Xiaotian Sun, Xuelun Shen, Yao Dai, Sheng Ao, Yangyang Shi, Jakob Engel, Zhipeng Cai, Cheng Wang

Abstract: Image-to-LiDAR registration estimates the camera pose of an image with respect to a LiDAR point cloud. It has diverse applications in autonomous driving, robot navigation etc. However, state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods still 1) mostly assume same-frame inputs, struggling with the image and point cloud from distant frames; 2) rely on domain-specific training, failing to generalize to unseen scenarios. We propose ZIL, the first foundation model for zero-shot non-synchronized image-to-LiDAR registration. ZIL encodes the input image and point cloud with the Vision and Point Transformers. In addition to regressing the relative pose, ZIL also learns to predict 3D coordinates, which substantially improves the pose accuracy without additional annotations. Interestingly, naive mix-data training cannot enable zero-shot generalization, which requires normalization on both camera intrinsics and the LiDAR vertical-axis origin. Trained on 7 public datasets with 1.4M LiDAR frames, ZIL consistently and significantly outperforms previous SOTA with a single model across 5 in-domain and zero-shot benchmarks, reducing the translation and rotation errors by up to 87% and 76% (shown in Fig. 1). Code and models are available at https://github.com/ZijunLi7/ZIL.

中文摘要：图像到LiDAR配准旨在估计图像相对于LiDAR点云的相机位姿，在自动驾驶、机器人导航等领域有广泛应用。然而现有最先进方法仍存在两点不足：一是大多假设图像与点云来自同一帧，难以处理远距离帧的输入；二是依赖特定领域训练，无法泛化到未见场景。本文提出ZIL，首个用于零样本非同步图像到LiDAR配准的基础模型。ZIL使用视觉Transformer和点云Transformer分别编码输入图像与点云。除回归相对位姿外，ZIL还学习预测三维坐标，从而在无需额外标注的情况下显著提升位姿精度。有趣的是，简单的混合数据训练无法实现零样本泛化，需要对相机内参和LiDAR垂直轴原点进行归一化。ZIL在7个公开数据集、140万LiDAR帧上训练，以单一模型在5个域内和零样本基准上持续显著超越此前最先进方法，平移和旋转误差最多降低87%和76%。代码与模型已开源。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作表明跨模态配准的零样本泛化依赖于对相机内参与LiDAR垂直轴原点的归一化处理，这一发现对多源地理空间数据融合中的坐标与传感器参数标准化具有方法启示。

相关度：62/100 该文提出零样本图像-LiDAR配准基础模型，属于多源数据融合与跨模态空间对齐方向，与地理空间智能中的多模态数据融合有方法层面的关联，但与城市更新、时空数据挖掘的直接联系较弱。

item.title: PanoSeg3R: Feed-Forward 3D Semantic Segmentation for Panoramic Images with an Automatic Data Curation Pipeline
item.description:
中文标题：PanoSeg3R：面向全景图像的前馈三维语义分割与自动数据策展流程

作者：Heechan Yoon, Dongki Jung, Phuc Nguyen, Ming Lin, Dinesh Manocha

Abstract: We present PanoSeg3R, a feed-forward framework for 3D panoramic semantic segmentation. Unlike existing methods designed for perspective inputs, PanoSeg3R jointly predicts 3D geometry and multi-view semantic segmentation in one single forward pass. Built upon a pretrained reconstruction backbone that supports panoramic images, our approach extends feed-forward 3D reconstruction with a query-based mask decoder. Furthermore, we introduce an automatic panorama data curation pipeline that leverages the complementary strengths of off-the-shelf foundation models to generate reliable pseudo semantic annotations, substantially expanding the training data and improving zero-shot generalization. PanoSeg3R achieves state-of-the-art performance on panoramic 3D semantic segmentation, improving 3D mIoU by up to 16.02 on ScanNet++, while the curated training data further improves zero-shot performance by up to 4.26 and 43.28 mIoU on Stanford2D3D and ToF-360, respectively. Website: https://harryyoon777.github.io/PanoSeg3R/

中文摘要：本文提出PanoSeg3R，一种用于三维全景语义分割的前馈框架。与面向透视输入设计的现有方法不同，PanoSeg3R在单次前向传播中联合预测三维几何与多视角语义分割。该方法建立在支持全景图像的预训练重建骨干之上，通过基于查询的掩码解码器扩展前馈三维重建。此外，作者引入自动全景数据策展流程，利用现成基础模型的互补优势生成可靠的伪语义标注，大幅扩展训练数据并提升零样本泛化能力。PanoSeg3R在全景三维语义分割上达到最先进性能，在ScanNet++上三维mIoU最多提升16.02，而策展训练数据进一步在Stanford2D3D和ToF-360上分别将零样本性能提升最多4.26和43.28 mIoU。

研究启发（模型推断）：该文利用基础模型生成伪标注以扩展训练数据的策略，对遥感与地理空间领域中标注稀缺场景下的数据增强与零样本迁移具有参考价值。

相关度：68/100 该文提出全景图像的前馈三维语义分割框架与自动数据策展流程，涉及三维场景理解、伪标签生成与零样本泛化，与遥感变化检测、多源数据融合及地理空间智能有较强方法关联。

item.title: The Wisdom of Artificial Deliberative Crowds
item.description:
中文标题：人工审议式群体的智慧

作者：Federico Barrera-Lemarchand, Mariano Sigman, Joaquin Navajas

Abstract: The aggregation of many lay estimates often outperforms individual expert judgment, a phenomenon known as the wisdom of crowds. While this is usually attributed to the independence of estimates, an even stronger effect arises through deliberation: averaging the consensus estimates of small deliberating groups outperforms the classical wisdom of crowds, with individual judgments themselves also becoming more accurate after deliberation. Whether these improvements transfer to large language models deliberating amongst themselves is unknown. Here we adapt a three-stage deliberation paradigm previously used with human participants for use with large language models from three different families, and test it across four domains of increasing real-world stakes: visual numerical estimation (Study 1), peer review of machine-learning papers (Study 2), detection of hidden malicious behavior by an artificial intelligence agent (Study 3), and sports forecasting against a real prediction market (Study 4). Across domains, deliberation reduced collective error beyond passive aggregation of independent responses, and post-deliberation individual judgments retained this collective gain. Notably, the advantage required model diversity: groups composed of clones of a single model did not benefit from deliberating. These results establish machine deliberation as a general-purpose aggregation mechanism, and point to diversity as an active ingredient.

中文摘要：该研究将原本用于人类参与者的三阶段审议范式迁移至三个不同家族的大语言模型，并在四个现实风险递增的领域进行测试：视觉数值估计（研究1）、机器学习论文同行评审（研究2）、检测人工智能代理的隐藏恶意行为（研究3）以及对抗真实预测市场的体育预测（研究4）。结果显示，在所有领域中，审议均比独立回答的被动聚合更能降低集体误差，且审议后的个体判断仍保留了集体增益。值得注意的是，这一优势需要模型多样性：由单一模型克隆组成的群体无法从审议中获益。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究提示，多智能体系统中引入异质性模型可能比同质模型集成更有效，这一发现或可迁移至城市更新场景中多源异构数据或多角色智能体的协同决策框架设计，但需注意其验证领域与地理空间任务存在显著差异。

相关度：62/100 该研究探讨大语言模型之间的审议式聚合机制，发现模型多样性是集体增益的关键条件，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向直接相关，但其应用场景（视觉估计、同行评审、恶意行为检测、体育预测）与城市更新或地理空间分析无直接联系。
